description: Get a single thread from the official Canton Network community forum (Discourse at forum-style discussions on ccpedia.xyz) by numeric topic id: title, category, view/post counts, and the first ~15 posts. Canton-only, served from CCPEDIA's cached forum index. This is the WEB FORUM. For GitHub Discussions use get_github_discussion, for sync.global mailing-list threads use get_mailing_thread. Get the id from search results or trending.

id.description: Forum topic ID from a search result, e.g. 3242 or "topic:3242". Not a doc-page id: those go to get_doc.

name: get_discussion
